mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.10% and remains below this threshold for 30 days, it signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.10% for 30 days, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates housing market recovery that drives consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines and HOUST increases, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), a sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening that reduces recession risk and boosts equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently supports consumer spending growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has risen over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 96.0 and remains above this level for 30 days, it signals manufacturing sector strength that drives corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 96.0 for 30 days, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates manufacturing-led economic recovery that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases and HOUST decreases, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 2.0%), a CPIAUCSL rise above 2.5% signals inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth < 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
